title: Fixed Footed Stator and Cage Rotor Motor Cutaway
description: One wholly newly authored complete horizontal electric-motor-style cutaway display. Four whole integral-shoulder feet carry a constant-diameter thick case with a deliberate upper-near longitudinal cut. A separate thick annular stator-like body and two complete copper-coloured end-winding-loop appearances surround a genuine interior rotor interval. One long bored rotor-core exterior carries one continuous ring-and-skew-bar cage whose two complete annular ends and twelve axial bars share actual material roots; spaces between those bars remain real geometry. One full through shaft projects from two separate complete stepped, genuinely bored end shields. A closed side terminal-box exterior with a proud blank lid belongs to the case. This whole coaxial stator/core/cage/end-shield organisation is not the older U-shaped magnet with exposed winding rotor, split rings and hand crank, and it is not a front fan with a small solid core inside a long tapered bypass cowl. All visible geometry newly authored, no old generator, engine, fan or rotor meshes imported or extracted. One complete prop zero scenes, four opaque untextured PBR roles, metres native Z up and full horizontal-envelope-centred foot datum. This is an invented static illustrative appearance with simplified end windings and deliberately fixed support overlaps, not an accurate motor section, winding diagram or manufactured assembly. No electric circuit, wiring, insulation, magnetic field, voltage, current, induction, rotation, torque, cooling, heat, efficiency, bearing fit, electrical compatibility, manufacture, installation, operation or equipment safety capability. Rigging animation and interaction not made or verified.
